title: Jeweled Smoky Egyptian Olive Skewers
description: Rich and crunchy Egyptian dish featuring castelvetrano olives, smoke cold, and whole30 friendly ingredients, perfect for a special occasion or gathering
instructions: Soak the bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes before starting to prepare the dish.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the pitted castelvetrano olives to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread 2-3 olives onto each bamboo skewer, leaving a small space between each olive.
Heat a large wok over medium-high heat and add a small amount of olive oil to the pan.
Add the skewers to the wok and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the olives are slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the wok and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skewers immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
